🚀 Built an automated FX Arbitrage engine - and let AI handle the trade audit
An end-to-end algorithmic FX system that captures zero-risk triangular arbitrage across multi-currency loops (USD/EUR/GBP/JPY), routing every trade through ML slippage checks and cost matrices before execution

🔄 Pipeline Workflow
Ingress - Streams real-time prices across target currency pairs
Simulation - Feeds a custom LP simulator to model spreads & inventory skew
Discovery - Evaluates 6 cross-currency paths in parallel to isolate mispricings
Filtering - XGBoost regressor predicts real-time slippage friction pre-execution
Costing - Validates gross margin against commission scales & clearing fees
Execution - Auto-fires order streams, updates telemetry, webhooks to an LLM audit layer

🛠️ Core Engineering Features & Security
Fully autonomous - runs as a continuous background daemon thread, processing trade cycles end-to-end without manual intervention
Auto-executing engine - fires the instant a net-profitable anomaly clears all risk gates
RBAC across Trader / Risk Manager / Ops Analyst with scoped permissions
Bcrypt-hashed credentials + secure cookie-based session management
AI Commentary Layer - Groq/Llama 3.3 70B auto-generates plain-English compliance logs per trade
Kill switch - dashboard-exposed emergency freeze for all execution threads
Dynamic safety nets - monitors drawdown limits, auto-freezes on breach
Granular cost thresholds - bakes exact commissions + clearing fees into execution math
Slippage filtering - XGBoost aborts routes if predicted slippage eats target yield
Timing-aware routing - checks latency & time-of-day volatility to hedge execution windows

🕹️ Live Sandbox Demo – https://lnkd.in/g5dHQsgt
Trader: trader/trader123 - full visibility, order scaling, manual overrides
Risk Manager: risk_mgr/risk123 - threshold management, kill switch access
Ops Analyst: ops_analyst/ops123 - read-only DB + AI audit logs

⚖️ Architectural Tradeoffs
Latency vs. free API limits: Production needs FIX WebSockets, sandbox is stuck on 35s REST polling - so I decoupled ingestion from the core engine, letting it scale to sub-ms feeds with zero code changes
Static prices vs. quote depth: Public feeds only give flat prices, not real quote books - so I engineered a synthetic LP Book Simulator to approximate order depth, spreads, and inventory skew
Telemetry vs. throughput: Sync logging was blocking trading threads - so I built an async pipeline that logs without stalling execution

🎓Beyond the Code: What This Project Taught Me
Rusty at first (hadn't coded in a year), but got back in flow. Learned failure-safety > latency - risk gates & kill switches are as core as the logic itself

🎯Next: taking this into derivatives, with real-world infra and live market data
